process_note: The sfnl-prompt-master skill is not available to this subagent, so I worked without it. The task was a fixed-definition hunt in any case.
conviction_note: The bar is the company's own Q3 guide, RMB898.6-998.4m (0-10% y/y decline). Two things decide the print: whether the company misses again after Q2 came in 5% under its own range, and the first Q4 guide, which the segment arithmetic puts flat to down about 10% y/y against a +20% Q4 2025. Against that, the stock is down about 50% since the Q2 print and its market cap (US$154m) is roughly its June 30 cash (US$155.6m). The two pull against each other, so p_up is 47 on a 9% absolute move. The findings sum to -1.9 and the scaled number is -0.54. The scaled number is smaller because the low-expectations finding is sized on its own while p_up nets the two sides.
bar: Company Q3 2026 guide: total net revenues RMB898.6m-998.4m, about 0% to -10% y/y against Q3 2025 RMB998.4m. Midpoint RMB948.5m is the bar used. Sources: https://finviz.com/news/387828/yatsen-announces-second-quarter-2026-financial-results (2026-09-02) and https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/yatsen-announces-third-quarter-2025-financial-results-302616686.html (Q3 2025 base). No sell-side consensus was found: TipRanks shows no ratings in the last three months, stockanalysis shows no analyst count, and Seeking Alpha's FY2026 consensus is dated April 2026. The company guide is the only sourced bar. Market trades on revenue vs guide and the next-quarter guide; there is no EPS bar.

expectations.last_print: Q2 2026 (2026-09-02): revenue RMB1.14bn, +5.1% y/y, below the company's own Q2 guide of RMB1.20-1.30bn (+10-20%). Net loss widened to RMB90.8m, gross margin fell to 73.9% from 78.3% on colour-cosmetics inventory provisions, and the company guided Q3 to a decline. The stock fell -4.89% on the day and -6.32% the next (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/YSG/), then about -50% to now. Before that: Q3 2025 beat its guide (+47.5%) and fell -20.32%; Q4 2025 landed in its guide range and fell -8.99%; Q1 2026 landed in its guide range and rose +3.86%.

expectations.real_bar: For the stock to rise, the release has to show Q3 revenue inside the RMB898.6-998.4m range with no second miss, a first Q4 guide no worse than about -10% y/y against Q4 2025's RMB1.38bn, and cash burn that leaves the market cap (about US$154m) visibly backed by cash. Margin progress from the colour-cosmetics clean-up would help.

next_guide.company_current_guide: none for Q4 2026. The company guides one quarter ahead; the Q3 guide is RMB898.6-998.4m (0 to -10% y/y).
next_guide.basis: Q4 2025 was RMB1.38bn (+20.1%: skincare +51.9% at 61.1% of revenue, colour -9.1%). Skincare growth has decelerated from +58.5% in Q1 to +40.4% in Q2 and an implied roughly +17-37% in Q3 (if colour keeps falling about 36%). Colour is being cut deliberately (-35.8% in Q2). Carrying that forward (colour -35%, skincare +20%) gives Q4 about RMB1.36bn, about -1.5% y/y, so the company's usual 10-point range likely spans roughly +0% to -10% or worse. That is a second consecutive y/y decline guide in Q4, the 11.11 quarter.

findings.finding: Q2 2026 revenue of RMB1.14bn (+5.1% y/y) came in 5% below the bottom of the company's own Q2 guide (RMB1.20-1.30bn, +10-20%). It was the first miss after Q3 2025 beat its guide and Q4 2025 and Q1 2026 landed inside theirs. The Q3 bar is again the company's guide, RMB898.6-998.4m (midpoint RMB948.5m). With colour cosmetics shrinking about 36% and skincare decelerating, the print is more likely in the lower half of the range than above it. A second miss below RMB898.6m would be a credibility event.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (missed own guide): -4.89% day, -6.32% next day. Q3 2025 (beat guide, +47.5%): -20.32%. Q4 2025 (inside guide): -8.99%. Q1 2026 (inside guide, +22.5%): +3.86%. The stock has not paid for beats on the reported line.
findings.why_not_priced: The guide is public, so a print inside it is priced. What is not settled is whether the company can still hit its own range after the Q2 miss. With no sell-side estimate to anchor it, the market has nothing between the guide and the miss risk. Had the market fully priced a second miss, the stock would not have bounced from $1.58 to $1.67 on Nov 23.
findings.independence: The Q2 actual and Q3 guide come from the Q2 release (https://finviz.com/news/387828/yatsen-announces-second-quarter-2026-financial-results). The Q2 guide comes from the Q1 release coverage (Nasdaq). Both are company documents; the track record is an inference from them.

findings.finding: Expectations are already very low. The stock fell from about $3.3 before the Q2 print to $1.63 (-21.6% in 5 days, -31.8% in 20 days, 3% off the 52w low), and market cap is US$153.8m on 93.8m ADSs, about equal to June 30 cash, restricted cash and short-term investments of RMB1.06bn (US$155.6m). The last sourced target is about $4 from a single analyst. A release that merely holds the guide and shows controlled burn clears a bar well below the company guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The decline guide in Q2 drew only -4.9% on the day while the stock was at about $3.3. The 50% slide since then came without company news, so the decline guide has been priced and then some. This name sold off after its last strong quarter (Q3 2025, -20%).
findings.why_not_priced: This is the price itself, so it is priced by definition. The question is whether the release clears that low bar. If the market expected guide compliance plus a stable cash pile, a stock trading at cash with no option market and no analysts would not have fallen another 17% on Nov 20 without news. The slide looks like capitulation or tax-loss selling, not information.
findings.independence: Cash figure from the Q2 release (https://finviz.com/news/387828/yatsen-announces-second-quarter-2026-financial-results); price path from https://www.quiverquant.com/stock/YSG/historical-prices/. Caveat: Q3 is a seasonal cash-burn quarter (Q3 2025 operating outflow was RMB126.8m), and the US$60m first-tranche convertible is debt against that cash, so net cash is lower than the headline.

findings.finding: The first Q4 2026 guide is likely to be a second consecutive y/y decline. Q4 2025 was RMB1.38bn (+20.1%: skincare +51.9% at 61.1% of revenue, colour -9.1%). Skincare growth has decelerated from +58.5% in Q1 to +40.4% in Q2 and an implied roughly 17-37% in Q3, while colour is being streamlined at -35.8%. Carrying that forward gives Q4 near RMB1.36bn (about -1.5%), so a range around 0% to -10%. In the 11.11 quarter last year, higher traffic costs also cut Q4 non-GAAP profit 54.6%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 print with a Q4 guide of +15-30%: -20.32%. Q2 2026 print with a Q3 decline guide: -4.89%. Guides have moved this stock more than the reported quarter.
findings.why_not_priced: There is no street Q4 number and no guide yet. The market knows Q3 is guided down but has no stated Q4 comp; holders may hope 11.11 and the skincare channel expansion (JD, Vipshop, offline, duty-free) restore growth. If a Q4 decline were fully priced, the stock would sit flat into the print, not bounce on Nov 23.
findings.independence: Q4 2025 split from the Q4 release coverage (Yahoo). Segment trends from the Q1 release (https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/yatsen-q1-earnings-call-highlights) and the Q2 release (https://finviz.com/news/387828/yatsen-announces-second-quarter-2026-financial-results). Q4 2025 11.11 cost note from https://m.winshang.com/news739724.html. The Q4 estimate is my arithmetic, not a document.

findings.finding: Peer Proya (Chinese skincare-led brand owner, same Tmall/Douyin channels) reported Q3 2026 revenue +29.76% to RMB2.253bn, but net profit -61.18%, which it attributed to higher brand-promotion spend. The stock fell about 8% on 2026-10-30. The Q3 channel demand for skincare was healthy, but spend to win it compressed margins.
findings.link: Both are Chinese domestic beauty brand owners selling mainly through Tmall and Douyin; skincare is about 71.5% of Yatsen's Q2 revenue and the core of Proya's. They share no customers and no supply link; the tie is the channel and the cost of traffic on it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Yatsen's S&M rose to 70.7% of revenue in Q2 2026 from 66.5% and the operating loss more than doubled. The stock fell -4.89% that day.
findings.why_not_priced: Proya reported after Yatsen's last call and nothing from Yatsen has followed. The read-across is margin pressure, not revenue. Yatsen's slide since October may already reflect sector margin fear, so this is small.
findings.independence: Same direction as the Douyin traffic-cost finding (different source: https://cj.sina.com.cn/articles/view/7746407306/1cdb8cb8a00102zyh8).

findings.finding: During the 2026 11.11 run-up, paid-traffic share on Douyin rose to 63.6% of beauty sales for domestic brands, from 45.1% a year earlier (蝉妈妈 data, Oct 9-21). H1 2026 Douyin beauty GMV growth slowed to 14.48% from 24.1%. Douyin is Yatsen's main skincare channel, and management already blamed higher Douyin traffic costs for S&M rising to 70.7% of revenue in Q2. This points to continued Q3/Q4 marketing-cost pressure and a cautious Q4 margin outlook.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4 2025 non-GAAP profit fell 54.6% on 11.11 traffic costs and the Q4 print drew -8.99% (March 2026).
findings.why_not_priced: This is industry data in Chinese trade press, not on the wire. It is still a proxy for Yatsen's costs and the company has not confirmed it for Q3/Q4.
findings.independence: H1 Douyin GMV deceleration from a different article (https://www.huxiu.com/article/4900823.html, 2026-10-27). Company confirmation of rising Douyin costs in Q2: https://www.tradingkey.com/news/transcripts/262147196-tradingkey.

findings.finding: The second US$60m tranche of the RMB-denominated convertible notes (conversion price US$4.63 per ADS, 1.5% coupon, purchaser vehicle of Trustar/CITIC Capital, founder Huang and Hillhouse) was 'expected to be issued later this year', subject to conditions including an NDRC certificate. EDGAR shows no 6-K announcing its closing (latest filing a Form 3 on 2026-09-15). The release or call will likely update it. A closing adds about 40% of market cap in cash from insiders at nearly 3x spot; a delay or termination removes it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Placement announcement 2026-03-11: +10.47%. First-tranche closing with Hillhouse 2026-05-21: +9.13%. Financing news has moved this stock up.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody has reported on the tranche since May. At $1.63 against a $4.63 conversion price the market may doubt it closes; if it were priced as certain, the stock would not trade at cash. The money funds R&D, overseas expansion and M&A, not a revenue ramp, and the sign depends on whether it closes, so it is sized 0.
findings.independence: Terms and NDRC condition from the March 11 release (https://ir.yatsenglobal.com/2026-03-11-Yatsen-Announces-Private-Placement-of-Convertible-Notes-and-Warrants). The absence of a closing 6-K comes from https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001819580.json (read 2026-11-24).

findings.why_not_priced: It is the price itself. It could be a block exit by a holder (overhang cleared), informed selling, or November tax-loss selling in a stock down 70% on the year. There is no way to tell which.

findings.finding: China's cosmetics retail sales rose 6.1% y/y in Jan-Sep 2026 and 5.4% in September (NBS via 证券市场周刊). The 16 listed Chinese cosmetics companies had median 9M revenue growth of 7.82%, with widening divergence. The category is growing modestly, so Yatsen's guided decline is company-specific (colour streamlining), not a market collapse.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a broad public series; it bears on the Q4 guide only through the skincare half. It is a macro proxy, so it is small.
findings.independence: Proya's Q3 +29.8% (https://m.sfccn.com/2026/10-30/wMMDE0MDdfMjI4NzkwMA.html) is consistent with healthy skincare demand.

findings.finding: Q2 gross margin fell 440bp to 73.9% on colour-cosmetics inventory provisions, and management said it is 'actively streamlining' the colour portfolio with no end date given. Further provisions in Q3 are plausible while colour revenue keeps shrinking (it was guided implicitly into Q3's decline).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 margin drop and widened loss drew -4.89% / -6.32% over two days.
findings.why_not_priced: No margin guide was given and there is no estimate, so the market has no number for Q3 gross margin. Management said underlying margin was 'broadly stable' ex-provisions, which may anchor holders on a recovery to about 78%.
findings.independence: The Q2 release (https://finviz.com/news/387828/yatsen-announces-second-quarter-2026-financial-results) shares the document family with the transcript, so it counts as one source.

baseline_tension: No skew is available (unusable chain). The run-up (-31.8% in 20 days, -21.6% in 5) is strongly negative. My negatives (next guide, margin, traffic cost) agree with that slide and are therefore partly priced. The one positive, expectations at cash value, cuts against it, so p_up sits near 50 (47) rather than at a confident short.
lessons_applied: Lesson 5 (an unexplained drawdown in a microcap is worth 0): the abnormal-volume / no-news finding moved from -0.3 to 0.0.

Lesson on untrustworthy FPI history: rebuilt the base rate from confirmed releases only (Q2'25 +0.63, Q3'25 -20.32, Q4'25 -8.99, Q1'26 +3.86, Q2'26 -4.89; median abs 4.89, mean 7.7) after dropping the Mar 11 and May 21 financing dates and the duplicate row. abs_move_pct went from 10 to 9; the core forbids shrinking it further, and realised vol is 114%.
Lesson 1 (this name sells beats): the low-expectations finding moved from +2.0 to +1.5.

Lessons 5/9 (proxy and segment arithmetic, not a company document): the next-guide finding moved from -2.0 to -1.5, the Douyin traffic-cost proxy from -0.7 to -0.5, and the guide-miss risk from -1.0 to -0.8, because the bar is the company's own guide and the miss risk is inferred from one prior miss.

Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the second tranche was kept at 0 after asking what the money buys. It funds R&D, overseas expansion and M&A, not a visible revenue ramp, and whether it closes is unknown.
Lesson 7: checked short interest before the negatives; it is about 0.2% of float, so the negatives were not shrunk for a squeeze.
